summary: Twelve reproduced recovery, financial, persistence and contract findings block readiness.

findings.body: Pre-start recovery omits case.workflowRunId; approve/reject409. Persist ID and test recovered API approval.
Resume never reacquires suspended dispatch; case waiting_approval guard skips active postapproval/presuspend work. Connect resume lifecycle, inspect actual snapshots and test post-refund crash.
Random message/outbox IDs duplicate replies on active-step replay; split commits. Stable identities and atomic case/message/outbox finalization, conflict-checked replay.
Production deliverOutbox bypasses registered accounts for localRuntime. Repro0 registered calls while local receipt appeared. Resolve each persisted binding.
30s leases never renew; healthy work restarted. Completion/retry by ID permits stale overwrite. Add ownership token, heartbeat and fenced writes; slow/stale-worker tests.
Third crashed claim remains claimed forever, attempts>=3 excluded. Reconcile receipts or visibly fail exhausted expired dispatch/outbox; crash exhaustion tests.
Recovered failure updates dispatch only; case stays new/processing, failed outbox hidden by resolved case. Persist workflow failure, expose workflow/action/delivery status.
event_source_externalId global primary key collides across accounts despite scoped lookup. Scope storage ID; same-production-ID cross-account test.
Message insertion failure commits case JSON alone; replay returns early leaving missing row. Atomic CAS create/update/append; trigger rollback/retry tests.
Mutable command with recomputed hash executes under old boolean approval; immutable action unused. Repro100 approved replaced200 executed. Bind decision to immutable action/hash; reject replacement.
Malformed response minor0.5/currency??? accepted; invalid delivery fields coerced and persisted. Shared runtime request/result schemas at both boundaries; negative conformance.
Reset deletes receipts but preserves outbox, enabling new effect on same key. Preserve receipt history or refuse reset after effects; runtime+CLI test.

evidence: Independent full diff review and installed Mastra restart docs

Three disposable SQLite programs confirmed event collision, recovery failure visibility, exhausted claims, registry bypass, missing run ID, non-atomic append, approved command substitution, malformed HTTP, receipt loss
